about: Strings for the Persian injection matrix (#517). Synthetic or copied from contract/vectors; never dictated by a person. Invisible characters are written as \u escapes so the file can be reviewed. Changing any text requires bumping fixture_set_version.

fixtures.text: kubectl get pods --namespace prod && cat src/main.py
fixtures.why: ASCII flags, an operator and a path: if this fails, the harness or the focus is wrong, not Unicode handling. Same string as scripts/appprobe/probe.sh.
Two Persian words and one space: the smallest RTL case.
ZWNJ (U+200C) inside two words. A backend that drops it joins the letters; one that turns it into a space splits the word.
Two ZWNJ in a row must arrive as two, not be collapsed.
ZWNJ at the very start and end of the burst, where trimming code is most likely to eat it.
Persian kaf/yeh next to their Arabic look-alikes. A keyboard-layout or normalisation step that maps one to the other changes the text while looking identical.

fixtures.text: من با VS Code و YazSes کار می‌کنم
fixtures.why: Latin product names embedded in a Persian sentence, plus a ZWNJ word.

fixtures.text: ایمیل من user@example.com است؛ مسیر /usr/local/bin/yazses را ببینید
fixtures.why: An email address and a POSIX path inside Persian, with the Persian semicolon.
ASCII, Persian (U+06F0..) and Arabic-Indic (U+0660..) digits in one burst. A backend that maps digits through the keyboard layout converts one family into another.
Persian comma and question mark next to an ASCII question mark.
Guillemets, colon, Persian semicolon and question mark, and parentheses, which bidi rendering mirrors on screen but must not change in the code points.
Explicit RLE/PDF bidi controls are invisible; they must survive injection unchanged.

fixtures.text: خیلی عالی بود 🚀 دستت درد نکنه 🙏
fixtures.why: Astral-plane emoji (U+1F680, U+1F64F) between Persian words: one code point, two UTF-16 units.
A ZWJ sequence, a variation selector and a skin-tone modifier: each is several code points that render as one glyph, so a visual check cannot catch a dropped part.

fixtures.text:
خط اول
خط دوم با English
خط سوم ۳
fixtures.why: Three lines. A newline must arrive as one U+000A, not CRLF, not a space, not nothing.
A Windows path with backslashes and a Persian file name, then a home-relative path with a Persian directory.
